notes:
A350 and 777:
• Fixed: The sim no longer warns that the GPU memory is full because of the mod.
• Improved: Screens you can't see use no extra memory.
App:
• New: Sharp screens switch in Settings. Off (default): uses much less graphics memory, the screens are only a little softer up close. On: the sharpest screens, for strong graphics cards. After changing it, press Update on the aircraft with the sim closed.
